currency.editor.codeHint: Three uppercase ISO 4217 letters; can't be changed after creation
currency.editor.codePattern: Enter three uppercase letters, such as AED.
currency.editor.conflict: This currency was updated elsewhere. Your draft is kept; close this dialog, refresh the list and edit again.
currency.editor.draftHint: A new currency is saved as a draft and isn't used anywhere until it's enabled.
currency.editor.minorUnitRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
currency.editor.name: English Name
currency.editor.nameHint: The ISO 4217 English name, stored as data; pages localize the displayed name.
currency.editor.numericCodeRequired: Enter the three-digit ISO numeric code.
currency.editor.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the change.
currency.logo.addressPattern: Use a file address such as /files/v1/123.
currency.logo.blocked: This currency's numeric code, name or symbol is missing; complete them through a reviewed SQL change before changing the icon.
currency.logo.frozenChanged: This currency's standard attributes changed since the page loaded. Refresh the list and change the icon again.
currency.logo.manualHint: You can't upload files here; upload a public file on the File Upload page and paste its file address.
currency.logo.notice: Only the displayed icon changes; books, postings and existing business are unaffected. The change is audited.
currency.logo.rejected: Platform rejected the icon: the file doesn't exist or isn't a public file that passed its check. Upload it again.
currency.logo.required: Upload or enter the new icon.
currency.logo.uploadHint: The file goes to the public bucket; the file address /files/v1/'{fileId}' is saved.
currency.panel.disableHint: Disabling only blocks new uses such as creating a book.
currency.panel.draftMeta: Draft · version {version} · not yet available for new business
currency.panel.frozen: Standard attributes are frozen once enabled. Correct them through a reviewed SQL change.
currency.specs.column.name: Name
currency.specs.footnote: The name is the ISO English name (data); currency names on pages follow the interface language. Currencies without an icon show their symbol.
currency.specs.intro: ISO 4217 currency codes, names, symbols, decimal places and rounding. Drafts can change every attribute; once enabled the standard attributes are frozen and only the icon can change; disabling only blocks new uses.
currency.specs.selectHint: Select a currency to see its details
currency.specs.unavailable: The currency list can't be loaded right now
currency.statusChange.disableNotice: Existing books and billing facts are processed as usual; only new uses, such as creating a book, are blocked.
currency.statusChange.enableNotice: Check again: {minorUnit, plural, one {# decimal place} other {# decimal places}}, rounding mode {roundingMode}. Once enabled, the decimal places and rounding mode can't be changed, and the currency code can't be recreated.
